open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a call of an operation the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant does not give the calling service is refused with OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS before any module is called and changes nothing: the CABINET member reading a customer's billing data, the PRESUPRO member publishing an artifact pointer and the CABINET_KERNEL member reading a project's context; that a token held by no service is refused with NO_VALID_TOKEN exactly as a wrong one; that a repeat of a create carrying an earlier request id is refused so too, never answered as a repeat; and that only a call of the CABINET_KERNEL member acts with an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind, a call of any other service never acting for an agent session.
open_points.other_text: from app.data_provider import OWNER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS, REFUSAL_STAGE_AGENT_SESSION, REFUSAL_STAGE_AUTHENTICATION, REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES, SERVICE_AGENT_SESSION_HEADER
open_points.question: Must SERVICE_RIGHTS be added to IMPORTS and its imported data-access signature, or must the note stop claiming and using that imported constant?

open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST first identify the caller through identify_service with presented_token and answer its Refusal through _refused; then, when request is None, MUST answer through _refused a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names and one failure of the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member of = models.RefusalKind whose path is one PathElement naming operation; when its operation is not the value of a member of = models.ServiceOperation and so outside every service's rights, or when service_may_call for the service and that member answers may_call false, MUST answer through _refused a Refusal with the NOT_PERMITTED member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_AUTHENTICATION constant names and one failure of the OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS member of = models.RefusalKind with an empty path, reading no record; only then, when the request's inputs are None, MUST it answer through _refused a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names and one failure of the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member of = models.RefusalKind whose path is one PathElement naming inputs, calling no module.
open_points.other_text: perform_service_operation: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a call of an operation the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant does not give the calling service is refused with OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS before any module is called and changes nothing: the CABINET member reading a customer's billing data, the PRESUPRO member publishing an artifact pointer and the CABINET_KERNEL member reading a project's context; that a token held by no service is refused with NO_VALID_TOKEN exactly as a wrong one; that a repeat of a create carrying an earlier request id is refused so too, never answered as a repeat; and that only a call of the CABINET_KERNEL member acts with an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind, a call of any other service never acting for an agent session.
open_points.question: Must “before any module is called” exclude the required identify_service and service_may_call calls, or must the required authorization sequence change?

open_points.subject: ServiceCallStep.run
open_points.text: ServiceCallStep.run: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer an input that the module's contract requires and the inputs leave None, through _refused, as a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names and one failure of the MISSING_VALUE member of = models.RefusalKind whose path is one PathElement naming that input, calling no module; a pointer not given MUST be handed on as a GivenPointer whose every field is None, so that its module refuses its missing values.
open_points.other_text: ServiceCallStep.run: [ORCHESTRATION] For the WITHDRAW_ARTIFACT_POINTER member of = models.ServiceOperation, a change, it MUST, for Kernel, resolve the pointer's project through project_of_pointer before the check, refuse a pointer_id of None or a pointer it does not find with the same Refusal as a refused check, its path naming pointer_id, without the check and before any check of a missing value, and check with on_project true and that project; then call withdraw_pointer with the inputs' pointer_id, the call's principal and instant, and answer its PointerWithdrawn as a PointerAnswer of its pointer with changed None.
open_points.question: Must a missing pointer_id receive the general INVALID_REQUEST/MISSING_VALUE refusal without calling a module, or the withdrawal-specific AGENT_CALL_REFUSED-style refusal after project_of_pointer?
